## Result and scope

Refs #419

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/419#issuecomment-6887725705, session `ADB991-claude-20261115-e5ac`.
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026 (C13). Report only: `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C13/review/ADB991-claude-20261115-e5ac/` (`report.md`, `hashes.json`). The author's text is not edited.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

This is an independent review, from an account other than the author's, of draft PR #420 @ `ab094b8` (stacked on #411 @ `e8284b4`): `lem:rank-trace-running`, the revised `lem:rank-trace-endpoint` and `prop:rank-trace-chart-window`.

**Outcome: mathematics accepted locally; Lean correspondence faithful; no required change.**
- Every step checks: the index dictionary L_i = L_{J(i+1)} and S_i = s_i; the shift of the shooting line by β̄ − β_*; the uniformity of E_i in N and p; E_i = o(s_i) from the drift floor; and the absorption of c_R in the endpoint lemma.
- S1 (should fix): state explicitly that β_{N,p,m} is the coupling of the history selected in `sec:common-funded-history`. I checked this identification against `restarted-rank-history.tex` l.213–216 and the source (`follows_prices`, `bush_start`).
- N1–N4 (optional): the letter b denotes both the base arc and the level-zero coupling; the weaker bound |b−β̄| ≤ β̄/2; the indexing of J_{i+1}; a possible shortening of the proof.
- Lean: in the source `Selected.reaches` gives b = β_* = `clock.bar`, and `Running` has no additive constant, so the manuscript's c_R is a harmless generalisation. `follows_prices` is the same endpoint bound.
- The lemma remains conditional on eq:shoot-adjacent-drift for the actual histories. This PR does not change that status.
